Class StructureEdits

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureEdits
public final class StructureEdits extends Object
A saved list of editing steps that can be applied to a fragment or written as JSON.

Steps run in order. Use StructureEditor when you want to edit directly; use this class when you want to save or reuse the same edits.
